meta.one_liner: Buy when the 50-day average crosses above the 200-day. The most famous trend signal there is.
meta.explainer_md: The 'golden cross' happens when a stock's average price over the last 50 days rises above its average over the last 200 days — a sign the trend may be turning up. The strategy simply holds while the 50-day stays on top, and sells when it drops back below (the 'death cross'). It's slow by design: it misses tops and bottoms, but historically kept you in big uptrends and out of long slides.

spec.name: Golden Cross
